    About the Elo system

    Every SMP player has an Elo rating. Win a fight and it goes up; lose and it drops. Beating a higher-rated player is worth more than beating a lower-rated one, so climbing means taking on the best.

    Your rating decides your classification on the leaderboard:

    • Rookie700+
    • Combat Novice950+
    • Combat Cadet1200+
    • Combat Specialist1450+
    • Combat Ace1700+
    • Combat Master1950+

    Server rules

    The baseline expectations for everyone in Relique. Breaking these gets you muted, kicked, or banned depending on severity — staff have final say.

    Discord and general

    General conduct

    1. Be respectful. No harassment, hate speech, or targeted insults — in text, voice, or DMs between members while representing the server.
    2. No spam or self-promo. Don't flood channels, mass-mention people, or advertise other servers/content without staff approval.
    3. Keep it SFW. No NSFW content, links, or usernames/profile pictures anywhere in the server.
    4. Use the right channel. Keep discussion on-topic — general chat for chat, support channels for help requests, etc.
    5. No cheating or exploits. X-ray, hacked clients, duplication glitches, and known bugs are bannable. Report bugs to staff instead of abusing them.
    6. Listen to staff. Moderator and admin decisions are final in the moment — appeal through the proper channel if you disagree.

    In-game rules

    Combat & PvP

    1. No combat logging. This includes vision logging and chase logging. Combat timer is 1 minute.
    2. No Elytra in combat or vision.
    3. Banned in combat: End Crystals, Respawn Anchors, and bed bombing.
    4. TNT minecarts are allowed for traps and PvP, with a 3.5 hearts damage cap.

    Cheats & Exploits

    1. No duping, hacking, cheating, or glitch abuse.
    2. No hacked clients, world maps, seed cracking, or similar tools.
    3. Minimap, Freecam, and FriendGuard mods are not allowed.
    4. Replay is allowed but must not be used unfairly.

    World & Gameplay

    1. The End is closed until the End War event.
    2. Do not interfere in ongoing cases.
    3. No loophole abuse.

    Spawn rules

    1. No PvP, ambushes, or griefing at spawn.
    2. Do not break or place unnecessary blocks at spawn.
    3. No FriendGuard.
    4. No killing players at spawn who are building.
    5. No fighting inside spawn. This will be strictly enforced.
    6. Do not run into spawn during a fight to save yourself. Doing so will result in punishment.
    7. Do not use /home or any teleport commands while within range of other players, or to escape a fight.

    Player safety

    1. New players are protected for their first 30 minutes.
    2. Don't farm naked players at spawn.

    Naked player protection

    1. No killing naked players within a 200x200 area of spawn.
    2. If the naked player steals your items or attacks you, you are permitted to kill them.

    Teams & alliances

    1. Maximum 12 players per team.
    2. All teams must be registered.
    3. No allied team is allowed.

    Temporary alliances

    1. Short-term teaming is allowed only to take down an overpowered player (example: a mace user).
    2. These alliances must end immediately once the threat is gone.
    3. Permanent alliances are not allowed.
    4. Base sharing with temporary allies is not allowed.

    Targeting & fairness

    1. Targeting one strong player first in a public fight (including at spawn) is allowed for balance purposes, not favoritism.
    2. Use basic logic and fair judgment during fights.

    Enforcement

    1. Abusing the alliance rule to form long-term teams or gain an unfair advantage will result in punishment.
    2. Replay or recording is required as proof. Breaking these rules may result in punishment or removal from the server.

    Accounts & IOUs

    1. IOUs require physical proof only.
    2. IOUs with allies or temporary teammates are invalid.

    Replay requirement

    1. Replay Mod must be ON at all times.
    2. Replay must not be used unfairly.
    3. No replay means no valid proof.

    Important

    Replay Mod is not valid hacking proof due to delay. The same applies to Flashback. Replay/Flashback is valid for showing combat logs, vision logs, and similar evidence.

    Reports & punishment

    1. Rule breaks must be reported to the owner or an admin.
    2. The reporting player helps choose the punishment from options given by the owner.

    Staff enforcement

    Enforcement

    Warnings & strikes

    Most first offenses get a warning. Repeated or severe violations escalate straight to a mute, kick, or ban at staff discretion.

    Appeals

    Think a punishment was a mistake? Open a ticket in the support channel and a staff member will review it.

    Rules are subject to change — check back if you're unsure about something.

    Infuse SMP S3

    Season 3 of Infuse SMP — a private competitive survival server with 13 craftable Effects, ranked Elo, 30 player ranks, and exactly one Mace on the whole server.

    What is Infuse SMP S3?

    Infuse SMP Season 3 is a private, invite-only competitive Minecraft survival server built around a unique crafted Effects system. You craft powerful Effects, equip two at a time, and activate each with a keybind. Kill a player to gain a positive effect (or remove a negative one). Die and you lose a positive effect (or gain a negative one). With 13 unique Effects, a ranked Elo ladder, 30 player ranks, and exactly one Mace in the entire world, every fight has real consequences.

    1

    13 Effects

    Craft and equip two Effects at a time. Each has a passive ability and an active Spark ability you trigger with a keybind.

    2

    Kill & Die

    Kill someone: gain a positive effect or remove a negative one. Die: lose a positive effect or gain a negative one.

    3

    Ranked Elo

    Every fight affects your Elo rating. Beat someone rated higher and climb faster. Lose to a weaker player and drop more.

    4

    30 Ranks

    Ranks #1–#30 are taken in combat. Kill someone to steal their rank. Your rank scales hearts, potion duration, XP gain and inventory size.

    All 13 Effects

    Each Effect has a passive that is always active while equipped, and a Spark ability triggered with a keybind. 8 are Primary Effects, 4 are Support Effects, plus the special Ender effect.

    Crafting & Rituals

    The brewing stand is replaced with a custom crafting table UI. Each effect type can only be crafted a limited number of times — and the first one crafted is always Augmented (half cooldown). Crafting an Augmented Effect starts a server-wide Ritual.

    • First craft = Augmented — The first effect of each type ever crafted gets half the cooldown of a regular one.
    • Batch limit — After the first (Augmented), only 3 more regular copies can be crafted. Then uncraftable forever.
    • Ender is special — Only 1 Ender effect can ever be crafted and it is never Augmented (0 Augmented copies), so it does not start a Ritual.
    • Ritual triggered — Crafting an Augmented effect starts a 10-minute Ritual. The crafting coordinates are broadcast to every player on the server.
    • Grab it — When the Ritual ends, the Augmented effect is spawned. The first player to pick it up owns it.
    • Coordinates announced — Every single effect craft — augmented or regular — broadcasts its location server-wide. Choose where you craft carefully.

    Commands

    • /lspark & /rspark — Activate the effect in your left or right slot.
    • /controls — Toggle between Command Keys and offhand activation mode.
    • /drain left / /drain right — Convert your equipped effect back into a bottle for trading or storage.
    • /swap — Swap the order of your two equipped effects.
    • /recipes — View all effect crafting recipes in-game, including limits.
    • /trust add <player> — Mark a teammate as trusted so your AOE effects won't hit them.

    Client Setup Required

    To activate effect abilities with keybinds you need the Bind Commands mod. Press ESC → Mods → Bind Commands → Configure, then bind /infuse:infuse use_spark left and /infuse:infuse use_spark right to two keys (e.g. G and V).

    Ranked SMP

    A competitive survival server where every fight moves your Elo and ranks #1 to #30 are won in combat.

    What is Ranked SMP?

    On Ranked SMP every player holds a numbered rank from #1 to #30, and a lower number is stronger. Your rank decides how many hearts you have, how fast you earn XP, how long your potions last and how much extra storage you can open with /inv. Nobody earns a rank by playing longer. You take it from someone else.

    1

    Ranks #1 to #30

    Ranks are dealt out when a season starts. Players who join later receive any ranks that are left over. Everyone without a rank is unranked, with 10 hearts and no bonuses.

    2

    Kill to take a rank

    Killing a player steals their rank. There is no limit on how far apart the two ranks are, and no cooldown between steals.

    3

    Stay online

    A rank holder who stays offline for 2 days loses the rank. It goes to a random online player who has no rank yet.

    4

    Perks scale with rank

    Hearts, XP gain, potion duration and extra slots shrink one step at a time from #1 down to #30. Slide through them in the explorer below.

    Your rank is announced as a tag like [#7] in join, leave and death messages. Every fight also moves your Elo rating, and the top 20 players by Elo are listed live on the Activity page.

    The Hierarchy Hammer

    The Hierarchy Hammer is the weapon built for ranked fights. It dashes you into your target and rewards you for landing hit after hit without missing.

    ʜɪᴇʀᴀʀᴄʜʏ ʜᴀᴍᴍᴇʀ

    A powerful hammer that manifested as a result of improper judgement

    SENTENCING RMB
    Launch forward, allowing you to initiate hits with the weapon. This dash will stop cooldown when a successful hit is initiated. Missing an attack will put it on cooldown.

    VERDICT
    After hitting 3 consecutive hits without missing, your next hit is empowered.

    • Streak 3 smashes
    • Reset 5 s
    • Miss cooldown 10 s
    • Verdict cooldown 30 s
    • Verdict damage 20 hearts
    1. RMB

      Sentencing: the dash

      Right-click to launch forward and start a hit. Land the hit and the dash cooldown stops, so you can dash again straight away. Miss and the dash goes on a 10 second cooldown.

    2. x3

      Build a streak

      Every hit made while falling at least 1.5 blocks counts as a smash and deals normal mace smash damage. Three smashes in a row without a miss charge your next hit. The streak resets after 5 seconds without a smash.

    3. 40

      Verdict: the empowered hit

      The fourth hit deals 40 damage, which is 20 hearts. That is a full health bar for a #1 ranked player. After a Verdict the hammer is on a 30 second cooldown.

    The hammer cannot be stored in chests, barrels, shulker boxes, hoppers or /inv. It can be dropped. If you die holding it, a skull of ash and smoke rises where you fell for 5 seconds. Staff hand it out with /rsmp give hammer. The server also has a Diamond Spear with Lunge III that never breaks, and a Dragon Egg whose carrier shows on everyone's locator bar.

    Strength SMP

    Every player carries a weapon and a strength score from -3 to +5. Reach 0 to wake the passive, hit +5 to unleash the ultimate.

    How it works

    Your strength score decides what your weapon can do. Lose it and you lose your edge, so every kill and every death counts.

    Crown and hammer

    Two server-wide titles that change who is hunted.

    The Monarch

    • Starts at +5 strength and gains +1 every real day, up to +8
    • Wears a bound crown and glows gold
    • Whoever kills the Monarch takes the crown and the title
    • The dethroned Monarch drops to 0 strength
    • Admins use /monarch random|set|clear|info

    The Ban Hammer

    • An unbreakable mace made from a Mace and a Dragon Egg
    • Anyone it kills is permanently banned
    • Only one can ever be crafted
    • Crafting it is announced to the whole server
    • Players with the bypass permission cannot be banned by it
